title: Tomo Tag Handler Group Result
description: A composed group from the tag-handler-interpreter skill (skill→reducer interface). One group = all handled[] items sharing the same (handler, target_path) pair, composed into a single block. Spec: docs/XDD/specs/024-tag-handler-framework/ SDD §5 + README decisions.

schema_version.description: Schema version sentinel. Always '1' for this revision.

handler.description: ID of the tag-handler that claimed all items in this group.

target_path.description: Resolved vault-relative path of the target note, or null when the target map had no entry for the captured vars. A null group is surfaced (not silently dropped) — consumers must guard.

marker.description: Anchor string in the target note (mirrors tag-handler config, e.g. '## Captures').

composed_block.description: The merged content block for this group — either the output of one LLM compose call (directive path) or the mechanical join of field values (template path).

source_paths.description: Vault-relative paths of all inbox items in this group (for traceability / suggestion rendering).

placement.description: Insertion position relative to the anchor. Mirrors tag-handler config.

compose_mode.description: How the composed_block was produced: 'llm_directive' = one LLM merge call; 'field_template' = deterministic field join (no LLM).
